{{External|rs|rsc=Rune Kite Shield}} {{Infobox Item |name = Rune kiteshield |image = [[File:Rune kiteshield.png]] |release = [[13 August]] [[2001]] |update = Wilderness system online |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A large metal shield. |value = 54400 |weight = 5.443 |exchange = Yes |id = 1201 }} [[File:Rune kiteshield detail.png|left|130px]] The '''Rune kiteshield''' is the second best smithable [[kiteshield]], surpassed only by the [[Dragon kiteshield]]. The rune kiteshield requires 40 [[Defence]] to wield. A player with 97 [[Smithing]] can make the shield by using three [[runite bar]]s and a [[hammer]] on an [[anvil]], granting 225 Smithing [[experience]]. The rune kiteshield is often used as a tank shield by low-risk and [[Void Knight equipment|void]] rangers; despite the negative [[ranged]] attack bonus, it is much cheaper, and provides a substantial [[melee]] defence bonus, which the [[Odium ward]] lacks. Players with at least level 43 [[Crafting]] are also able to paint the rune kiteshield at a [[player-owned house]] to create an untradeable [[Heraldic kiteshield (Construction)|heraldic shield]], provided that they have visited [[Sir Renitee]] to obtain a crest in advance. A painted rune kiteshield will provide protection in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. It will also turn [[Bandit (Bandit Camp)|bandits]] hostile, if painted in the colours of [[Saradomin]] or [[Zamorak]]. Any monster that has access to the [[rare drop table]] can also drop the rune kiteshield. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -8 |arange = -3 |dstab = 44 |dslash = 48 |dcrush = 46 |dmagic = -1 |drange = 46 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = shield |image = [[File:Rune kiteshield equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Rune kiteshield equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 97 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 225 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Runite bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Rune kiteshield }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Rune kiteshield}} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Rune kiteshield}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Rune kiteshield}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Rune kiteshield}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The shield's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -2 to -3. }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 May 2004 |update = Bigger Banks & Treasure Trails |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Rune kiteshield detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Rune kiteshield detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Rune kiteshield (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Rune kiteshield.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 –
